long_description.before:
WeReno is the AI operating layer for property improvement. We spent more than a decade representing property owners, coordinating contractors, and managing renovations and capital projects. Across that time, we’ve helped facilitate $1B+ in project value and turned that operating playbook into AI agents that help property owners and contractors get work done.

Handyman.ai helps homeowners handle everyday repairs and maintenance. Renobot.ai represents homeowners through renovations. Opsonic.ai gives contractors an AI back office for quoting, scheduling, follow-up, and operations. Capital by WeReno manages complex commercial projects.
long_description.after:
While building WeReno.com, we managed over $1B in renovations and noticed something: property owners kept coming back long after projects ended. We realized buildings have no memory, and every repair, maintenance issue, and service request starts from scratch.

So we built Handyman.ai, an AI agent that remembers your property, anticipates problems, and handles everything from maintenance to repairs.

In our first three months, we've facilitated $10M in GMV, validating the opportunity to build an AI agent for every property.

one_liner.before: The AI operating layer for property improvement.
one_liner.after: Handyman.ai by WeReno- The AI operating layer for property improvement

long_description.before:
Conntour enables government agencies to query video - from security cameras, body cams, and drones.

Users can search past footage (“Find a man with tattoos on his left arm”), configure real-time alerts (“Notify me if someone climbs over the wall”), and extract data (“How many pickup trucks entered yesterday?”).

Unlike traditional video analytics solutions, which are limited to fixed parameters (like a weapon, bag, or car color), Conntour supports an unlimited range of highly specific scenarios described in plain language. This enables a single human to monitor thousands of cameras, or find a specific moment in minutes instead of days.

What makes Conntour's technology unique is its ability to process video at scale, fully on-premises, with minimal hardware requirements.

Conntour is backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst and Y Combinator, selected for the first-ever Palantir Fellowship, and advised by Bob Flores - former CTO of the CIA.

long_description.before:
SalesPatriot is a back-office operating system for distributors and OEMS. We build custom AI workflows for sales and supply chain teams to manage procurement, requests for quote and purchase orders.

In large orgs that operate as key nodes of the supply chain data is scattered across twelve systems. Quotes get lost and Executives lack visibility. Supply chain workflows are time consuming because data isn't where it needs to be in the format it needs to be.

Employees are stuck between their email, ERP, CRM, marketplaces, and spreadsheets instead of winning business and protecting margin.
long_description.after:
SalesPatriot deploys supply chain superintelligence into distribution, original equipment manufacturing, and procurement. By embedding AI in the teams that run quote to cash workflows, we turn email chains, ERPs, websites, spreadsheets, and portals into a unified transactional layer, so critical parts reach the production line faster.

The West’s advantage depends on supply chains that work. We build and deploy the software that makes them work.

one_liner.before: AI powered operating system for distributors and OEMs
one_liner.after: Supply chain superintelligence for distribution and procurement

long_description.after:
Faraday builds industrial AI that learns how enterprises operate and executes long-horizon, multi-step tasks from the back office to the shop floor.

We sit on top of fragmented systems of record, coordinating work across existing software and teams. We combine operating procedures, enterprise data, and expert feedback to capture the rules and judgment behind complex processes. In customer-specific RL environments, we optimize the agent harness around each company’s systems, constraints, approvals, and exceptions.

We’re connecting to industrial hardware to bring live production data into the same feedback loop. Human corrections, machine data, and operating results help improve how agents plan and execute future work.

one_liner.before: Industrial aOS between humans, agents, and robots
one_liner.after: Agents running industrial enterprises from back office to shop floor

long_description.after:
Viraj Aero builds gas turbines that deliver both power and cooling water for data centers. It needs no grid connection and no water pipeline.

Burning natural gas already produces water. Our patent-pending system captures that water from the exhaust. Part of it cools the data center. The rest is turned into steam and injected back into the turbine. That gives up to 40% more power from the same fuel (cheaper compute) and cuts NOx emissions by up to 99%, which cuts permit approvals from years to weeks.

We're building a genset around our first-of-its-kind gas turbine. It fits in a 10-foot container and runs anywhere, even in the desert. That matters because two-thirds of new data centers are being built in water-stressed regions.

We first built this steam-injected turbine for aircraft, where carrying water tanks isn't an option and efficiency is critical. We're currently integrating our full-scale prototype into an aircraft. The team comes from GE, Rolls-Royce and Formula 1, and we're already working with Safran, one of the world's largest aircraft engine manufacturers.

one_liner.before: Running robot brains in the cloud

long_description.before: Opera (YC F26) is an automated operations research lab applying mathematics and AI to optimize operations for retail, logistics, manufacturing, agriculture and more, delivering solutions for VP of Operations, supply chain leaders, plant managers and COOs to improve efficiency and decision-making.
long_description.after: OpEra is the AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets. Companies with physical operations make thousands of decisions every day, and we help their teams make the best one at every step from production to delivery: (1) Planning: how much to make, buy and stock. (2) Scheduling: what runs when, and who works on what. (3) Allocation: which warehouse or store gets each order. (4) Routing: boat, plane or truck, and which route each one takes. Founded out of MIT's Operations Research Center.

one_liner.after: The AI decision engine for factories, warehouses and fleets
